issue.title: Repair Models-panel jump PNG monkeypatch after provider-state split
issue.description: Proposed by phase sase-mf.4 and independently reproduced by land agent on current master 3c3909c31: all three nodes in tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_models_panel_jump.py fail before rendering because _patch_alias_views monkeypatches models_panel_providers.build_alias_views, removed by de83c802d when provider state moved to models_panel_provider_state.py. Repoint the stale test seam to the owning module, preserve deterministic AliasView fixtures, and verify the three PNG snapshots plus the Models-panel visual suite. This is unrelated to sase-mf's alias migration; it is fallout from the concurrent module split.

payload.entry: Repointed the stale _patch_alias_views monkeypatch in tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_models_panel_jump.py from models_panel_providers.build_alias_views (removed by de83c802d) to models_panel_provider_state.build_alias_views, which is where load_provider_routing_snapshot() now actually calls it (models_panel.py's own direct import/usage was untouched and still worked). Also discovered the three committed PNG goldens (models_panel_jump_top_level_120x40, models_panel_jump_mixed_bucket_120x40, models_panel_jump_top_level_70x32) were stale from before commit 981106799 (docs: migrate docs and tests off retired model-alias names) renamed the deterministic AliasView fixtures (large_worker/medium_worker -> xsmall/small/medium/large/xlarge etc.); regenerated them with --sase-update-visual-snapshots since the fixtures module itself was untouched and the actual render now faithfully reflects current fixture data. Verified: .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_models_panel_jump.py -q -p no:randomly -m visual -> 3 passed, stable across repeated runs both with and without --sase-update-visual-snapshots.

Verified all three Models-panel jump PNG snapshot tests pass deterministically (3 passed, re-run twice for stability) after repointing the monkeypatch and regenerating stale goldens. just check's mypy gate and just test-scoped both still fail, but for a pre-existing, unrelated reason confirmed via git stash comparison against clean master: a HistoryWordCompletionMetadata ImportError from a separate history/word-ranking refactor (commit b5b7f761b) cascades into ~60+ prompt/completion test file collection errors and 2 mypy attr-defined errors, none touching models_panel or my changed files.
